路由已停止；仍需在本地路由中检查并恢复客户端接管。: The router is stopped. Check and restore any client takeover in Local routing.
新请求将要求本地访问令牌；所有令牌共享此处的速率与并发限制。: New requests will require a local access token. All tokens share the rate and concurrency limits set here.
本地模型请求不要求令牌；只读状态仍要求令牌。所有令牌共享此处的速率与并发限制。: Local model requests will not require a token; read-only status still requires one. All tokens share the rate and concurrency limits set here.
检查前置条件，修改认证、速率与并发: Check prerequisites, then edit authentication, rate and concurrency limits
按用途与期限检查、创建或撤销令牌: Review, create or revoke tokens by purpose and expiry
查看当前账本，再进入策略修改: Review the current ledger, then open policy editing
核对活动与未知费用，查看尝试或取消任务: Review active tasks and unknown costs, inspect attempts or cancel a task
检查前提、选择目标、授权收费并核对结果: Check prerequisites, select a target, authorize paid checks and review results
选择恢复版本，比较后确认回滚: Select a version to restore, compare it and confirm rollback
授权目录、指定文件、选择来源并审核差异: Authorize a directory, specify a file, choose a source and review differences
按类型和文字筛选已加载事件: Filter loaded events by type and text
从当前状态和待处理记录进入具体任务；选择入口不会执行写入或收费验收。: Open a task from the current state or records needing attention. Selecting an entry does not write data or run paid checks.
来自最近任务与验收记录；未知费用不是零，历史失败也不代表当前故障。: Based on recent tasks and check records. Unknown cost is not zero, and a historical failure does not imply a current fault.
已读取的记录中没有待核对项。: No records needing review were found in the loaded data.
显示 {visible} / {loaded} 条已加载事件；此筛选不搜索未加载: Showing {visible} of {loaded} loaded events. This filter does not search logs that have not been loaded.
实际派发模型须已有精确自定义价格；发送前再次校验。: The actual dispatched model must have an exact custom price. It is checked again before sending.
所选验收收据不在最近记录中，请刷新或查看其余记录。: The selected check receipt is not in the recent records. Refresh or review the other records.
先选择项目目录，再指定目标文件和来源；目录授权仅用于当前任务。: Select a project directory, then specify the target file and source. Directory authorization applies only to this task.
选择要写入此文件的内容: Choose content to write to this file
需核对包括未知费用和未预留的尝试；未知费用不按零计。: Review includes attempts with unknown cost or no reservation. Unknown costs are not treated as zero.
最近记录中没有活动或需核对的任务。可切换到全部最近任务。: No active tasks or tasks needing review appear in recent records. Switch to all recent tasks to see more.
选择要恢复的配置版本: Select a configuration version to restore
先选择已有版本，再比较当前配置与目标版本。确认回滚会覆盖快照范围，并自动备份当前: Select an existing version, then compare it with the current configuration. Confirming rollback replaces the snapshot scope and automatically backs up the current configuration.
